notes: Static, inspectable catalog of Claude Code telemetry destinations. Exact hosts only: no wildcard expansion, no historical blacklist imported at runtime, no online rules. Served for inspection by lintel-egress, the desktop egress module and every CLI (root and runner); it never opens a home, state directory, executable or real host network. `blockable` means the host is eligible for optional selection into an existing blocked configuration draft; `informational` entries are mixed or necessary purposes that must never be offered as one-click telemetry blocks. Recheck provider/enablement conditions before changing an entry.

destinations.purpose: Claude Code 运营指标（Datadog log intake）
destinations.provider: Datadog 接收端；模型 provider 为 direct Anthropic API
destinations.applicability: 仅 direct Anthropic API 的 Claude Code 可选启用；Bedrock、Google Agent Platform 与 Foundry 不使用此入口
destinations.version_applicability: 适用于当前官方文档描述的 Claude Code；未断言最低版本
destinations.collateral_impact: 阻止后无法送达该可选运营指标；不阻止模型请求或认证
